Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment 
 inspection, which must be performed 
 depending on 
 Dp 
 as indicated in the 
 above title block.
The first draft initiated by 
eng. Hesham M. Hassan, reviewed by director eng. Saad Mostafa, and revised by 
quality control eng. Samir Abdel Gelil at EDEPCo., accepted by general director eng. Ali Al-Lithy
and approved by eng. Mostafa Alam: Head Sector of Talkha Steam 
 Power Station 2x210MW
Technical Specification of these Filters
No. of 
 filter | 2
Filter type | SF 625
Mesh size 
 (mm) | 0.25
Mesh number
 (no. of eyes / cm) | 625
Safety Precautions
The filter must be isolated mechanically by closing :-
De-aerated filter by opening de-aeration valves.
A work permit must be issued, the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area,
Wear your safety helmet, shoes .... etc
The filter must be isolated mechanically by closing :-
De-aerated filter by opening de-aeration valves.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid.
Work
to be Carried Out
Dismantle 
the filter sieve insert from the filter body
Check closing of the input and output mazot valve
Check opening the de-aeration valves (5).
Wait until the pressure inside the filter is decreased to 
zero .
Screw off nuts (3) to remove cover (2) of the filter
Take out the filter insert from spindle(12).
Disassembly of the filter sieve insert
Screw off nuts (6)then take out the spindle (8) with spindle (12) and top & 
bottom covers (7) & (8)
Screw off spindle (12) from nut (11)
Screw off nuts (13) to remove spring (14).
Clean and repair filter insert parts
Clean every part of the filter insert specially filters sieves.
Check the sieves (9) and repair
damage part.
Check spring (14) and renewed it if needed
Check gasket (15) and renewed it if needed
Assembly of the filter sieve insert
Assembly every part in reverse sequence of disassembly.
Assembly of the filter's insert inside the filter body
Put the filter insert after assembly it inside the filter body.
Check gasket (14) and renewed it if needed.
Close filter body by cover (2) and tight nuts (3) in cross sequence .
Close de-aeration valves (5) and open equivalent valve to check any leakage .
Take the air inside the filter by open the valves (5) and close it 
directly when mazot come out.
